label: Reward vault with signed claims
summary: Immutable-signer EIP-712 ERC-20 reward claims with replay protection, deadlines and explicit context binding.
maturityMeaning: Deterministic reusable source is packaged and hash-bound; project integration, tests and review are still required.
dependencyRequirements: Standard ERC-20 reward token or project-specific received-balance accounting
requiredFacts: Bind signer custody, outcome provenance, context hash, nonce policy and maximum deadline
Fund the vault before claims and define exhaustion, cancellation and retirement behavior
Disclose transfer-tax, rebasing or callback behavior of the reward token
hardConflictPredicates: A signature can be replayed across chain, vault, recipient, amount or context
A claim can transfer more reward value than its signed authorization
A mutable signer can be replaced without an explicit disclosed delay and user-exit policy
